correctness.rationale: For any linear C subset F2^n of Hamming diameter <=3, pivot columns force dimension k<=3. Equal one-bit occurrence counts in the 2^k codewords force support s<=3(2^k-1)/2^(k-1), i.e. at most 5. The potential k=3,s=5 case is ruled out by seven rank-two hyperplanes: all meet the 5-column multiset in at least two entries, with total 15 incidence giving six 2s and one 3; pair intersections then count 9, contradicting 10 column pairs each sharing a hyperplane. Exhaustive s<=4 classification yields full-support counts (1,1,2,6,10) and rank refinement. Independent closure-enumeration for all binary subspaces in n=0..5 reproduced valid totals 1,2,5,16,51,136 and support ranks. Finite checks support, not replace, the arbitrary-n proof.
